title: The Tripling Frostlings
story: Deep in the Blue Hollow, Mr 6 finds 4 tiny frostlings nibbling the village's heat-stones. Glacewither's curse makes the whole brood triple in number at the end of every hour. Mr 6 knows the warding spell takes 4 hours to chant, so he must plan for how many frostlings will be waiting.
question: How many frostlings will there be after 4 hours of tripling?
solution: Each hour multiplies the brood by 3: hour 1 gives 4 * 3 = 12, hour 2 gives 12 * 3 = 36.
praise: Tripling step by step was the perfect plan — it just needed one more hour of tripling before stopping.
hint: Write the count at the end of each hour, one line per hour, and make sure you list four hours.
victory: Mr 6 chanted the ward just as frostling number 324 arrived, and the whole glittering brood melted into one harmless puddle that giggled.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight in a frost-blue ice cavern surrounded by hundreds of tiny glittering frostlings multiplying in waves, pale cold light bouncing off ice walls.
